title: Dukkha (1)
text: 1-3 Sāvatthi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Rādho Bhagavantam etad avoca || || Dukkhaṃ dukkhanti bhante vuccati || || Katamannu kho bhante dukkhanti || || 4 Rūpaṃ kho Rādha dukkhaṃ || vedanā dukkhā || saññā || saṅkhārā dukkhā || viññānaṃ dukkhaṃ || || 5 Evam passaṃ || pe || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
